newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates up on fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates up on fund shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates maintained their high levels on Thursday amid a shortage of funds and are likely to open at around current levels after the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.
The overnight funds were traded at 17 percent despite an inflow of 2.3 billion rupees on the maturity of paper sold in an open market operation, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
About 5.5 billion rupees were dicounted with the central bank by borrowers, he said. With no major inflow expected, the rates were likely to open around current levels on Sunday.
